messages:
Alex (sales): Quick pass to CS for Premier Health — signed yesterday, pilot + dedicated trial. Key notes: VIP customer, HIPAA data, will require VPC + KMS, renewal window in 11 months so flag any onboarding delays.
Tanya (cs): thanks Alex — pinging owners. Do we have expected go-live date for trial?
Alex (sales): onboarding window target is 3 weeks from now. They want end-to-end test of SSO and sample inference under 100ms p95.
Tanya (cs): noted. Initial checklist: provisioning, SSO (Okta), VPC peering, KMS setup, model access + quantization profile. Assigning owners: Mike for infra/support, Ravi for eng follow-ups.
Tanya (cs): @Mike (support) can you take lead on VPC & KMS provisioning? Also need quota increase for Dedicated pool.
Mike (support): on it. I’ll open infra ticket and request capacity bump. Can someone paste the customer subnet/cidr and KMS ARN?
Alex (sales): Subnet: 10.40.12.0/24, Preferred region: us-west-2, KMS arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01.
Mike (support): got it. Creating ticket: TB-4821. ETA for VPC peering + KMS: ~2 business days once creds confirmed.
Ravi (eng): I’ll triage the inference perf ask. What model do they want?
Alex (sales): prefer open Llama-2-13B tuned for summarization, will accept Redwood-recommended variant if perf/cost tradeoff better.
Ravi (eng): ok. I’ll run a quick perf matrix for 13B vs 7B quantized on gpus we plan to allocate. If we see >2x latency improvement with 7B and quality within thresholds, propose fallback.
Tanya (cs): also capture enablement: we need a product walkthrough + runbook for their SREs. I’ll schedule a 90-min enablement session the week after provision. Who owns the runbook?
Mike (support): I can start a draft runbook and link it to TB-4821. Will add steps: provisioning, KV cache warmup, canary routing config, and emergency rollback to hosted.
Ravi (eng): heads-up — there’s a known corner-case with private model loading under certain seq lengths; I’ll add regression test and note in the runbook.
Tanya (cs): good call. Flagging renewal risk: medium if onboarding slips >6 weeks. Marking renewal-watch and will create a weekly status update to sales + account exec.
Alex (sales): thanks — please include me on weekly updates. If they see stability issues we should offer a short SLA trial extension as goodwill.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: schedule enablement session (3 attendees min) — suggested times: Wed 10am or Thu 2pm PT.
Tanya (cs): proposing Wed 10am PT. I’ll send calendar invite after TB-4821 is created.
Mike (support): TB-4821 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TB-4821 — assigned to Mike, priority: High. Added infra owner and quota request.
Ravi (eng): created perf experiment doc and will post results in thread by EOD tomorrow.
Tanya (cs): next steps summary: 1) Mike: complete VPC/KMS + quota (TB-4821) 2) Ravi: perf matrix + regression test 3) Tanya: runbook draft + schedule enablement 4) Alex: provide any missing customer contacts + legal POC.
Alex (sales): sending legal + SRE contacts now. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
Mike (support): will update TB-4821 with progress and ETA.
Tanya (cs): I’ll post weekly status updates here starting Mon. If anything blocks beyond 72 hours ping #eng-oncall. :eyes:
Ravi (eng): noted. I’ll also gist the perf logs and include a minimal repro for the seq-length edge-case.
Alex (sales): appreciate it — keep this thread as the single source of truth for onboarding notes.
Tanya (cs): copying action owners into the calendar invite and closing this handoff.
